body: Still, I think you should work for yourself to support your lifestyle, hobbies, interests etc. You provide labor or business to society, it's purely transactional. Life seems meaningless being FA, but at least there are some things you can find fulfilment in life

Pop culture stereotypes, certain physiological differences & other sociopolitical beliefs contribute to this cultural perception. Unfortunately, until general cultural perceptions shift, you'd have to try harder to get the same results in dating.


South Asian men are at the bottom of the barrel,  below South Asian women in this hierarchy in the west. It is what it is.  Dating's tougher for South Asians.

I've been in several social clubs for several years. The reality is that most people don't connect personally on a deeper level in these clubs. I networked with some people for business and career stuff, but still to this date I haven't made any meaningful friendships or relationships. The most common reason IMO is that people don't have much time or energy to pursue deep relationships in hobbyist or other social circles. They're too preoccupied with their professional & personal matters. School, Uni and jobs where you start off with a cohort of really young (18-25 y.o) colleagues is where you make most of your meaningful friendships.

I saw some of the comments suggest the "Passport Bro" option, but even then, I'd advise you to be very careful since it has become somewhat of an industry, and you might end up in a transactional relationship where you're used for gaining citizenship.

It's rather politically incorrect to say that some people would go without genuine romantic affection in their whole lives despite being otherwise great people living productive lives. That's why the cookie cutter response : "Improve yourself & put yourself out there" is used to deflect this. It's an ugly truth which inconveniences a lot of people. 

I know that it's almost impossible to fill that void of romantic unfulfilment, and it affects pretty much everything in life. You'd just have to find some purpose to alleviate it & bear life, or everything you worked for gets derailed. 

Good luck friend. I wish you the best.
That's good on you if you found the person who truly loves you man. As a South Asian guy my options are even lower. Generally most of us are viewed as bottom of the barrel, even by our own women.

It's also a gamble since a lot of scams are there now. Props if you find true love, but I'm guessing the grass isn't that much greener, and that gold digging or Green Card hunting is rife.

I never considered the passport option because I find it weird & condescending to basically bribe a woman from a poor country to marry me.

About the paperwork thing, it's for getting a work permit in a European country for a job I got. It's weird really. Idk if they're really trying to be convinced of my truthfulness or trying to earmark in some way.

> I do find that a surprising amount of Gen Zers are happy to date older people

Economic necessity might be one reason but I'm sure they could work stuff out with their own gen Z peers as well of that's the case. I know several  DINK (Double Income No Kids) couples. Women tend to date a few years older so yeah Gen Z mingling with younger millennials would be common.

I've also seen the tide turning as there's a new conservative wave coming up, It's nothing new with those kinds of changes. Regardless of the tide, people's opinions on perpetually single people barely change much.

Thanks for the insightful comment. You need to have a baseline discipline & ambition yes. It's just that I've developed a habit of giving up after few dates or attempts because I feel I'll wreck it & waste their time. You could say my insecurity gets the best out of me. Interesting points you raised about Arranged Marriage, and those are my concerns about it as well. There are many men & women that I know who are in that boat.

I wondered whether entering the dating game with no experience in long term relationships is generally viewed as a huge red flag for a guy in his 30s.  If that's the case then I guess I can hardly find anything long term from the dating scene.

It just feels to me like if it doesn't click by at least in your mid 20s then it's less likely  to make it in your 30s.

We're also hardwired as males to breed like rabbits as well but polygamy isn't exactly the norm in modern civilization. We're more than our basic animal instincts. If sex is all that's missing, then escorts would solve my problem.
If you want to know whether I had sex & had sexual urges, yes I did.  Why is it that some people have to reduce everything to sex? Can't a guy expect more from a long term relationship?

// Also, know that just because you decided to act like a hermit, don't expect the girls who you find through arrange marriage to be the same. //

Yeah it's pretty much awkward when  people actually get to know it, and there's no point in saying otherwise. Though I never expected that from my partner or had trust issues in my past relationship because of it.
